necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical need to evaluate the patient's condition as described in the indication note.
